title: PRC Chart Theme
description: Committed fallback seed for Charts → Chart Theme (config + palettes). Generated from src/settings/field-registry/schema.mjs — do not edit by hand.

$schema.description: IDE schema pointer; stripped before persistence by Theme_Validator.

barGroupPadding.description: Padding between bar groups in grouped charts (0–1 fraction).

barPadding.description: Inner padding between individual bars (0–1 fraction).

hasRectStroke.description: Apply a border stroke around each bar rectangle.

forceStrength.description: Force layout: pull strength for x/y forces (0–1).

groupBy.description: Force layout: column whose values cluster around separate y centers.

layoutMode.description: Beeswarm layout algorithm (dodge = precise x, force = clustered).

swarmSpread.description: Dodge layout: max horizontal drift from anchor x (px). 0 = vertical stacks only.

abbreviateTicksDecimals.description: Decimal places when abbreviating tick labels.

angle.description: Rotation of the axis title (typically 270° for Y-axis readability).

dx.description: Horizontal nudge for the axis title.

dy.description: Vertical nudge for the axis title.

fontFamily.description: Axis title font stack (theme.json family picker; new charts only).

maxWidth.description: Max axis title width before wrapping (px).

padding.description: Gap between axis line and title (px).

domain.description: Explicit axis extent [min, max], or null to infer from data.

stroke.description: Color of grid lines (empty = inherit / none).

strokeDasharray.description: SVG dash pattern for grid lines.

nice.description: Round the axis domain to clean tick values (d3 nice). On by default to match how published charts have always rendered; disable to honor editor-set domains exactly.

showZero.description: Force zero to appear in the domain.

fontFamily.description: Tick label font stack (theme.json family picker; new charts only).

padding.description: Gap between tick mark and label (px).

tickMarksActive.description: Show tick mark lines on the axis.

tickUnit.description: Unit suffix/prefix appended to tick labels (e.g. "%", "$").

tickValues.description: Explicit tick values array; managed per-chart, not a theme default.

category.description: Column key whose values are displayed in the diff column.

headerFontFamily.description: Header font family (separate from cell text).

headerFontStyle.description: Header font style (separate from cell text).

headerFontWeight.description: Header font weight (separate from cell text).

negativeCategories.description: Column keys plotted on the negative side.

netNegativeCategory.description: Column key for the net negative bar.

netPositiveCategory.description: Column key for the net positive bar (optional summary bar).

category.description: Column key for the neutral bar.

offsetX.description: Horizontal offset of the neutral bar (px).

separator.description: Draw a separator line at the neutral bar.

separatorOffsetX.description: Horizontal offset of the separator line (px).

percentOfInnerWidth.description: Fraction of chart width used for the diverging bars (0–1).

positiveCategories.description: Column keys plotted on the positive side.

active.description: Show a secondary diverging bar layer.

categoryStyles.description: Per-category style overrides for secondary bars (managed per-chart, not a theme default).

negativeCategories.description: Column keys plotted on the secondary negative side.

positiveCategories.description: Column keys plotted on the secondary positive side.

showInLegend.description: Include secondary bars in the legend.

strokeDasharray.description: SVG dash pattern for the connecting line.

connectPoints.description: Draw a connecting line between dot pairs.

categories.description: Per-category error bar style overrides (managed per-chart, not a theme default).

customStyles.description: Per-datum error bar style overrides (managed per-chart, not a theme default).

stroke.description: Color of default error bar whiskers.

strokeDasharray.description: SVG dash pattern for error bars.

strokeWidth.description: Width of default error bar whiskers (px).

columnGap.description: Horizontal gap between exploded bar columns (px).

columnHeaderHeight.description: Height reserved for the dependent axis band when it is active (px).

emptyFill.description: Fill color for empty or missing cells.

minCellHeight.description: Minimum height for each data cell (px).

minCellWidth.description: Minimum width for each data cell (px).

rowLabelWidth.description: Optional gap between the independent axis line and the heat grid (px). Labels use chart left padding.

showValues.description: Show numeric values inside each cell.

abbreviateTicksDecimals.description: Decimal places when abbreviating tick labels.

dx.description: Horizontal nudge for the axis title.

dy.description: Vertical nudge for the axis title.

fontFamily.description: Axis title font stack (theme.json family picker; new charts only).

maxWidth.description: Max axis title width before wrapping (px).

padding.description: Gap between axis line and title (px).

dateFormat.description: Format applied when scale is "time" (strftime, e.g. "%-m/%Y").

domain.description: Explicit axis extent [min, max], or null to infer from data.

domainPadding.description: Extra padding added beyond the domain edges.

stroke.description: Color of grid lines (empty = inherit / none).

strokeDasharray.description: SVG dash pattern for grid lines.

padding.description: Space between axis line and chart edge (px).

showZero.description: Force zero to appear in the domain.

fontFamily.description: Tick label font stack (theme.json family picker; new charts only).

padding.description: Gap between tick mark and label (px).

tickMarksActive.description: Show tick mark lines on the axis.

tickUnit.description: Unit suffix/prefix appended to tick labels (e.g. "%", "$").

tickValues.description: Explicit tick values array; managed per-chart, not a theme default.

color.description: Label color token (`contrast` picks bar-aware fill; `inherit` uses series color).

customLabelFormat.description: Reserved for runtime custom format function.

customLabels.description: Per-datum label text overrides keyed by data row index.

customPositions.description: Per-datum position overrides keyed by data row index.

customStyles.description: Per-datum inline style overrides keyed by data row index.

customVisibility.description: Per-datum visibility overrides keyed by data row index.

declutterLeaderLines.description: Draw leader lines from decluttered labels to their anchor points.

declutterOmitEdgeWithin.description: Omit the remaining label in a crowded cluster when its anchor is this close to a plot edge (0 disables).

declutterOmitWithin.description: Omit labels whose anchors sit within this many pixels of a kept label (0 disables).

declutterPadding.description: Minimum padding between labels when auto-decluttering (px).

firstLastLabelLayout.description: Placement for first/last labels on line-family charts. `outside` puts the first label left of its point and the last label right; labelPositionDX/DY still apply on top.

fontFamily.description: Label font stack (theme.json family picker; new charts only).

labelCutoff.description: Min bar value to display a label (smaller bars are unlabelled).

labelPositionDX.description: Horizontal pixel nudge for label placement.

labelPositionDY.description: Vertical pixel nudge for label placement.

labelUnit.description: Unit string appended to label values (e.g. `"%"`).

minDisplayValue.description: Values below this read as `<value` rather than rounding to zero. Null (the default) formats every value normally. Unrelated to labelCutoff, which decides whether a label is drawn at all.

pieLabelRadius.description: Distance of pie/donut labels from the center (px).

showFirstLastPointsOnly.description: Only label the first and last data point (useful for line charts).

textOutline.description: Draw a contrasting outline around label text for readability.

textOutlineMode.description: Outline halo color strategy when textOutline is enabled (`background` = chart moat; `contrast` = opposite of label fill).

toLocaleString.description: Format numbers with locale-aware thousands separators.

truncateDecimal.description: Drop trailing zeros after the decimal point.

horizontalRules.description: Show horizontal grid rules behind the chart.

mobileBreakpoint.description: (DEPRECATED) Viewport width (px) at which mobile layout rules activate.

name.description: Internal block name identifier; not user-editable.

orientation.description: Rarely used. Controls the orientation of the chart. 'vertical' will display the chart vertically, and 'horizontal' will display the chart horizontally.

overflowX.description: Controls the overflow behavior of the chart. 'responsive' will scale the chart to fit the container, 'scroll' will allow the chart to scroll if it exceeds the container, and 'preserve-aspect-ratio' will preserve the aspect ratio of the chart.

bottom.description: Bottom inner padding of the SVG canvas (px).

left.description: Left inner padding of the SVG canvas (px).

right.description: Right inner padding of the SVG canvas (px).

top.description: Top inner padding of the SVG canvas (px).

parentClass.description: CSS class applied to the outermost wrapper element.

borderStroke.description: Border color of the legend box (empty = none).

categories.description: Override legend item order; uses `dataRender.categories` by default.

fill.description: Background fill of the legend box (empty = transparent).

fontFamily.description: Legend label font stack (theme.json family picker; new charts only).

labelDelimiter.description: Text between the lower and upper bound labels in map legends.

labelLower.description: Prefix label for the bottom range in map legends.

labelUpper.description: Prefix label for the top range in map legends.

showArea.description: Fill the area beneath the line.

showFirstLastPointsOnly.description: Only render markers on the first and last plotted point in each series.

showPoints.description: Render data point markers on the line.

strokeDasharray.description: SVG dash pattern for the line (e.g. `"4,2"`).

blockRectSize.description: Cell size for block-style cartogram maps (px).

customScale.description: Scale multiplier applied on top of the projection's default scale.

ignoredLabels.description: Additional state/country codes whose labels are suppressed.

ignoreSmallStateLabels.description: Suppress labels on small states/territories (RI, DC, etc.).

pathBackgroundFill.description: Fill for regions with no data.

projectionPreset.description: For world maps, pre-defined areas for render (eg. Europe, South Asia, Africa).

showStateBoundaries.description: Overlay state boundary lines on county and world maps.

topologyRegion.description: Which regional topology file to load for world maps.

alt.description: Accessible alt-text for static image exports.

active.description: Show net positive/negative value labels on stacked charts.
Show the negative net value label.

category.description: Column key whose values feed the negative net label.

color.description: Color of the negative net value label.

fontFamily.description: Font stack for negative net labels (theme.json family picker; new charts only).

fontSize.description: Font size of the negative net value label (px).

fontWeight.description: CSS font-weight of the negative net value label.

labelPositionDX.description: Horizontal nudge for the negative net value label.

labelPositionDY.description: Vertical nudge for the negative net value label.

labelUnit.description: Unit suffix/prefix appended to negative net values.

labelUnitPosition.description: Whether labelUnit appears before or after negative net values.

margin.description: Margin around the negative net value label (px).

textAnchor.description: SVG text-anchor for the negative net value label.

toFixedDecimal.description: Decimal places shown on negative net values.

toLocaleString.description: Format negative net values with locale-aware thousands separators.

truncateDecimal.description: Drop trailing zeros after the decimal point on negative net values.

active.description: Show the positive net value label.

category.description: Column key whose values feed the positive net label.

color.description: Color of the positive net value label.

fontFamily.description: Font stack for positive net labels (theme.json family picker; new charts only).

fontSize.description: Font size of the positive net value label (px).

fontWeight.description: CSS font-weight of the positive net value label.

labelPositionDX.description: Horizontal nudge for the positive net value label.

labelPositionDY.description: Vertical nudge for the positive net value label.

labelUnit.description: Unit suffix/prefix appended to positive net values.

labelUnitPosition.description: Whether labelUnit appears before or after positive net values.

margin.description: Margin around the positive net value label (px).

textAnchor.description: SVG text-anchor for the positive net value label.

toFixedDecimal.description: Decimal places shown on positive net values.

toLocaleString.description: Format positive net values with locale-aware thousands separators.

truncateDecimal.description: Drop trailing zeros after the decimal point on positive net values.

maxPointSize.description: Maximum marker radius when sizeCategory is set (px).

minPointSize.description: Minimum marker radius when sizeCategory is set (px).

pointFill.description: Fill color of markers (`"inherit"` uses series color).

sizeCategory.description: Table column used for proportional marker radius (null = uniform pointSize).

sizeScale.description: Scale type mapping sizeCategory values to radius.

strokeDasharray.description: Dash pattern for group arc lines.

hasPathStroke.description: Apply a stroke between pie segments.

innerRadius.description: Inner radius for donut charts (0 = solid pie).

showCategoryLabels.description: Render category name labels outside segments.

showGroupArcs.description: Render arc indicators around segment groups.

sortByValue.description: Sort segments by value (largest first) instead of data order.

allowDrag.description: Allow user to drag band positions (editor only).

allowResize.description: Allow user to resize bands (editor only).

bands.description: Array of band objects ({ from, to, color, … }); managed per-chart, not a theme default.

active.description: Overlay a regression line on the chart.

groupBreakStyles.description: Per-group style overrides for regression lines.

perGroupBreak.description: Compute a separate regression for each group break.

strokeDasharray.description: SVG dash pattern for the regression line.

sourceKey.description: Data column key for the link source node.

targetKey.description: Data column key for the link target node.

valueKey.description: Data column key for the link flow value.

customStyles.description: Per-series/category style overrides (keyed object; managed per-chart, not a theme default).

segmentsActive.description: Whether per-segment styling is active (managed per-chart, not a theme default).

segmentStyles.description: Per-segment style overrides for stacked charts (keyed object; managed per-chart, not a theme default).

axisTreatment.description: `"minimal"` shows y-axis on the first column and x labels on every panel; `"full"` draws complete axes (incl. independent grid) on every panel.

columns.description: Number of panel columns in the grid (desktop).

emphasisMode.description: `"own-series"` draws only the panel column; `"highlight"` ghosts sibling series (line panels only in MVP).

stroke.description: Stroke color for ghosted sibling series.

strokeWidth.description: Stroke width for ghosted sibling series (px).

minPanelWidth.description: Minimum panel cell width in px. When the container is narrower, columns restack until each panel meets this width.

panelHeight.description: Locked cell height in px (title + plot). Total SVG height is derived from panelHeight × rowCount.

active.description: Show the column-name title above each panel.

padding.description: Space reserved below the panel title (px).

textAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of the panel title (left|center|right).

panelType.description: Chart mark drawn in each panel.

sharedScale.description: Share one y-domain across all panels.

customFormat.description: Reserved for runtime custom format function.

dateFormat.description: Date format when axis scale is `"time"`.

emphasizeStrokeActive.description: Highlight hovered element with a stroke.

format.description: Mustache-style template for each tooltip row.

headerActive.description: Show a header row inside the tooltip.

minDisplayValue.description: Values below this read as `<value` rather than rounding to zero. Null (the default) formats every value normally.

mode.description: `point` resolves one data point per hover. `unified` reports every series plotted at the hovered x.

offsetX.description: Horizontal pixel offset of the tooltip box.

offsetY.description: Vertical pixel offset of the tooltip box.

fontFamily.description: Tooltip font stack (theme.json family picker; new charts only).

template.description: Rich HTML tooltip body. When non-null, takes precedence over format. Null keeps the legacy mustache format path.

toLocaleString.description: Format numbers with locale-aware thousands separators.

labelMinArea.description: Minimum cell area (px²) required to show a label.

opacityRange.description: Min/max opacity range when `scaleOpacity` is true.

paddingOuter.description: Outer padding around the treemap boundary (px).

showValues.description: Render the numeric value inside each cell.

cellGap.description: Padding between cells as a fraction of cell size.

cellShape.description: Shape used for each waffle cell.

cellSize.description: Preferred cell size in px (used by fixed and clamp modes).

cellSizeMode.description: fixed = exact size; auto = always fit; clamp = preferred size until overflow then scale down.

displayMode.description: Whole uses one grid; portion uses one mini grid per category.

emptyFill.description: Fill color for empty waffle cells.

max.description: Domain ceiling: what a full grid represents. Fill = value / max. Null uses sum (whole) or 100 (portion).

colors.description: Slug → hex swatch list. Keys are palette catalog slugs.

colorNames.description: Ordered palette catalog labels for the UI.
